known_differences.description: fsci-io implements MATLAB v4/v5 (incl. compressed miCOMPRESSED v7), Matrix Market, WAV PCM/float, NetCDF v1/v2, IDL .sav, Harwell-Boeing, ARFF, and Fortran unformatted I/O.

threats.description: Truncated or corrupted Matrix Market coordinate files claiming more nonzeros (nnz) than lines present, or out-of-bounds 1-based indices.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-io/src/lib.rs:368 (mmread): validates banner, dimensions, 1-based coordinate bounds, and exact nnz entry count before returning.
threats.strict_mode_response: Return Err(IoError) on truncated coordinate entries or out-of-bounds indices.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Reject malformed Matrix Market payloads fail-closed and record FailClosed in AuditLedger.

threats.description: Crafted MATLAB Level 5 miCOMPRESSED (zlib) or miMATRIX tags claiming multi-gigabyte dimensions or zip-bomb payloads.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-io/src/lib.rs:4555 (loadmat): bounds decompressed stream sizes, validates tag byte lengths against remaining slice, and rejects HDF5 v7.3 headers cleanly.
threats.strict_mode_response: Return Err(IoError) on truncated tags, corrupt zlib streams, or v7.3 HDF5 files.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Enforce strict decompression and dimension caps and emit FailClosed audit event.

threats.description: Non-finite entries in Matrix Market or MATLAB numeric arrays in Hardened mode.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-io/src/lib.rs:376 (mmread_with_mode): rejects NaN/Inf numeric entries when RuntimeMode::Hardened is selected.
threats.strict_mode_response: Parse IEEE NaN/Inf tokens per format specification.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Reject non-finite matrix entries fail-closed with IoError::NonFiniteInput.

threats.description: Endianness (IM vs MI) and Level 4 vs Level 5 MATLAB serialization round-trip drift against SciPy.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-io/src/lib.rs:4624 (savemat): writes canonical Level 5 or Level 4 headers and data elements matching SciPy savemat byte layout.
threats.strict_mode_response: Round-trip numeric, complex, logical, char, cell, struct, and sparse arrays matching SciPy 1.17.1.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Validate variable names and array dimensions before serialization.

fail_closed_policies.input_class: truncated or malformed file header / chunk length
fail_closed_policies.hardened_mode_action: Return IoError::FormatError and record FailClosed in AuditLedger.

fail_closed_policies.strict_mode_action: Return IoError explaining v7.3 HDF5 requires an HDF5 reader, matching SciPy NotImplementedError.
Allow IEEE NaN/Inf in Strict mode.
fail_closed_policies.hardened_mode_action: Reject non-finite entries in Hardened mode with IoError::NonFiniteInput.

fail_closed_policies.input_class: coordinate index out of declared matrix dimensions
fail_closed_policies.hardened_mode_action: Return IoError::FormatError and emit FailClosed audit event.
